en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex with towers and a church spire, overlooking a riverside town with small houses, industrial buildings, lumber stacks, and a riverbank in the foreground. The main caption in red at the bottom identifies the view as Meissen and specifically the royal Albrechtsburg castle. Additional German printing appears along the left edge and bottom margin.
